objective: Measure full per-feature winner and positive-activation behavior across the completed fuzzy TopK ladder without changing its model, optimizer, data order, or learning horizon.

hypotheses.dead_features: The 16D dictionary does not obtain its quality gain by leaving a large, persistent population of features inactive.
hypotheses.competition: Winner use within each fixed group remains distributed rather than collapsing onto one permanently dominant feature.
hypotheses.scaling: Dead-feature and competition statistics remain qualitatively stable from the 60M through 250M dense-equivalent tiers.

scope.reason: Only the fuzzy arm has the outer grouped selector whose neuron-level mechanism is under measurement. Existing dense and fuzzy quality endpoints remain the comparison reference; this rerun adds observations rather than a new treatment.

instrumentation.capture_schedule: optimizer step 1, every 10 steps, and the exact final optimizer step
instrumentation.batch_scope: global data-parallel batch after mesh-wide psum

metric_definitions.fuzzy.winner_frequency: fraction of sampled global-batch tokens for which the stored feature wins its fixed group before ReLU
metric_definitions.fuzzy.activation_frequency: fraction of sampled global-batch tokens for which the feature wins and its retained ReLU value is strictly positive
metric_definitions.fuzzy.activation_mean: unconditional mean retained activation, with zero on every token where the feature is inactive
metric_definitions.fuzzy.activation_rms: unconditional RMS retained activation, with zero on every token where the feature is inactive

instrumentation.gradient_interpretation: Positive activation frequency gives current-batch structural data-gradient support for the corresponding UP column and DOWN row. Adam momentum and weight decay can still produce a dense parameter delta.
instrumentation.runtime_isolation: Non-capture steps use the ordinary executable. Capture steps run a stateless forward-only observer before invoking the exact same ordinary/model-diagnostic update executable; this repeats one forward at 10% cadence but cannot alter update numerics. The observer reductions share its four choicewise decoder passes, only the controller transfers the result, and the growing file remains a dotted temporary excluded from periodic salvage rsync until one successful atomic rename.
instrumentation.browser_policy: Publish the cadence-10 raw vectors as the authoritative artifacts, exact full-neuron widening-step companions at 1, 10, ..., 200, 300, 500, 900, 1700, ... and final, compact layer reductions, and precomputed activation-frequency histograms/positive quantiles for the one-off study-browser explorer.

controls.meaning: feature captures aligned with the existing every-10-step model diagnostics

throughput_gate.acceptance: Measured cadence-10 training-time overhead must be no more than 20%. The observer must leave the ordinary optimizer trajectory unchanged. A failed gate blocks the nine quality-length runs pending implementation work.

combined_update_control.status: systems-only control for a rejected implementation

combined_update_treatment.status: rejected because placing feature auxiliaries inside the differentiated update selected a numerically different BF16 compiled path; throughput itself was not a problem
combined_update_treatment.archive_policy: exclude from the mechanism study and Hugging Face archive

trajectory_check: All nine training.riglog files are byte-identical to their same-tier, same-seed uninstrumented fuzzy runs in the sealed three-arm ladder.

archive.status: combined with the 500M extension in one 12-run Hugging Face study

launch_policy: After the throughput gate and standard v4-32 preflights pass, launch all nine cells sequentially at explicit sparsity-diagnostics cadence 10 in 60M, 125M, 250M order and increasing seed within tier. Do not retry, select, or stop based on intermediate loss or sparsity observations.
stopping_rule: Every admitted cell runs through its complete explicit cosine schedule. A systems failure stops the sequential queue for inspection.
